subject: Design Engineer (Civil), City of Rockingham (SEEK 95407006), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: The City's Design Services team prepares concept and detailed designs, drawings, quantities and cost estimates for roads, pavements, drainage, car parks, reserves and coastal facilities in the Capital Works Program.
letter.subject: Design Engineer (Civil), Design Services (SEEK 95407006)
paragraphs: I saw your Design Engineer (Civil) advert on SEEK and would like to apply. The role centres on road, pavement and stormwater drainage design for the Capital Works Program, which is the work I trained for.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and my coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, wrote site reports and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers, so I understand how design documentation is used in construction.

My Civil 3D and AutoCAD experience comes from study rather than commercial production work, and I have not yet used Main Roads WA standards on a job. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Rockingham. I hold a driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to discuss the role.

checklist: Confirm with Marc that he is willing to discuss relocating to Rockingham WA before applying

Check Gmail again for any City of Rockingham receipt, then open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95407006 and confirm it is still open (closes 4pm WA time Wednesday 4 November 2026, 7pm AEDT; applications are assessed as received)
Apply through the City's online application via the SEEK link out with the master resume and the saved cover letter PDF

Address the five selection criteria from facts only (road, pavement and drainage design and Civil 3D from Advanced Diploma coursework; do not claim commercial design experience or Main Roads WA standards)
Note the receipt date in /workspace/job-finds (tracker recording is paused)
notes: Council (local government) direct advert on SEEK, link out to the City's own online application. Selection criteria must be addressed in the application. Relocation to WA to be confirmed by Marc.
